title: Gate 2 evidence run CAPTURE lane: frames from the played route (S04 tournament, S05 Lower Meadows -> pond -> detour -> South Bridge)
_comment: GENERATED by tools/gate_f/derive_gate2_route_captures.py from the logic lanes' telemetry in this run directory. Do not hand-edit: re-run the generator. Every `teleport` here is a DIAG step and is recorded as one; the walking evidence is the logic lane's. This lane exists so the blind judge sees the route as played -- gameplay camera, HUD on, whatever spawned -- rather than posed stands.
